title: Marie's own: first novel (abandoned)
doubts: 046.0266 'roman cérébral' (8 Oct 1875) not treated as this novel; 059.0817 not a mention. Added 054.0298 (hero = Audiffret), 056.0408 (stopped). No text survives.

title: Marie: portrait of Collignon
doubts: Painted 23 May-20 June 1876 (9th sitting 12 Jun, finished 20 Jun). Possible 1885 cat. no. 75 'Portrait de Mlle C.' flagged not asserted. No image, whereabouts unknown.

title: Ariane (projet de statue)
doubts: Bare alias 'Ariadne' omitted on purpose (people/mentioned/ARIADNE.md exists; Ouida's novel Ariadne 096.0141-0156 is a different thing). 098.0551 'statue en grand' is Nausicaa; Ariadne is only the 'grande préoccupation'. Project never executed.

title: Marie's own: Prédiction de Cassandre
doubts: 26 stanzas 046.0156-0181 (6 Oct 1875), 38-stanza version 050.0381-0417 (2 Dec 1875). Kinship Léon/Émile d'Audiffret left open per LEON_D_AUDIFFRET ruling. Full text is in the diary itself.

title: Marie: sculpture group and bust for Nice exhibition
doubts: Group (076.0433) vs bust (077.0202) may be one object; authorship ('petite lâcheté', 'le pauvre artiste', Paul not in the secret) suggests help but is NOT asserted; whether it was shown is not recorded. Possible check: Nice press Jan 1878.

title: Marie's own: portrait of Olga Sapogenikoff
doubts: Begun 29 Mar 1875 with Marie Sapogenikoff (030.0403); colour 20 Sep 1875 (043.0247); Marie's later margin note 043.0249: never finished. Her 076.0447 'de quatorze à dix-sept pas un trait' contradicts the 1875 entries (recorded, not corrected).

title: Marie's own: study of a Christ-model (Katorbinsky)
doubts: Rome, 14 Jan 1876. 'First life painting' is Marie's contrast in 052.0150, not an absolute claim. KATORBINSKY remains an auto stub (people/mentioned).

title: Marie: portrait of grand-maman
doubts: 31 May-10 Jun 1877, enlarged from a small pastel. Grand-maman (maternal) died 1870 per GRAND_MAMAN, so posthumous - an inference. 'le prince' (071.0570) and 'Alexandre' (071.0618) unexplained.

title: Portrait de Jacques
doubts: Child model, oil, distinct from Jean et Jacques. Added 103.0150, 103.0187, 103.0437, 103.0697, 104.0434. March Union exhibit vs April-June 'reprends Jacques': same canvas or a second portrait? Open. 1885 cat. no. 42 'Jacques Rendouin' candidate only.

title: Alice Brisbane en Récamier (portrait)
doubts: First sitting 27 Apr 1880 (088.0016, 088.0028), finished 22 Apr 1881 (091.0504). Inventory's 091.0130 (apron) excluded - belongs to L'Atelier Julian. Male BRISBANE (091.0088) is another person.

title: Articles de P. Orell dans La Citoyenne
doubts: Articles not located (issue numbers/titles unverified; Gallica ark not found; Alexander Street is subscription). Persona created 1 Dec 1880 (090.0293). P_ORELL / PAULINE_ORELL stubs remain people/mentioned; lead may merge/redirect. full_text deliberately empty.

title: Le Meurtre de César (projet de tableau)
doubts: A painting ('Je ferai ce tableau', 102.0348), set in the Senate; not a relief (the grand bas-relief is Le Printemps). Added 102.0343, 0346-0350, 0444. 'Jules (pas César)' paragraphs 102.0413/0466 are another Jules.

title: Marie's own: Complainte de Girofla
doubts: First draft 043.0368-0379, fair copy 044.0002-0011 (21 Sep 1875); tune 'Madame l'Archiduchesse' as named by Marie, not sourced elsewhere. Cross-linked to batch 11's REVUE_DE_NICE.

title: Marie's own: Mignon parody and acrostic EMILE
doubts: Acrostic 23 Dec 1874 (027.0364-0369) reads as feminine - target probably Dina; which Emile unstated. Mignon parody 028.0020-0026 aimed at Hamilton. Mignon opera entry (culture/theater/MIGNON.md) still a stub.

title: Marie's own: mock-letter Rosière
doubts: Composed 9 Nov 1875 (049.0185-0191), recopied 5 Feb 1876 with ceremony moved to 22 May (053.0408). Never stated whether posted.

title: Marie's own: history painting-caricature (Godard etc.)
doubts: 23 Jul 1875 (037.0383-0386). Distinct from batch 11's GRANDE_CARICATURE_1875 (051.0298); cross-linked. Tour Audiffret reading is a guess, flagged.

title: Marie's own: caricature of Smirnoff
doubts: Made 30 Jul 1875 (037.0497), shown 22 Sep 1875 (044.0056); on canvas ('la toile'). No description of the picture.

title: Marie: portrait of Paul (brother)
doubts: CORRECTED earlier negative finding: 065.0503 (26 Aug 1876) and 066.0097 (8 Sep 1876, Gavronzi) record the sitting; 079.0510 is Paul de Cassagnac (wrong link). Footnote at 084.0240 ('only occasion') is now wrong in _original and all translation trees - lead to fix. Existing image kept.
